## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.17.3.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.17.3.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.17.3.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.17.3.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.17.3.

## What's new

- **Both manuals rewritten as numbered rulebooks.** Every rule has one
  number (two levels, such as 10.3) and is stated once; other pages point to
  it. Tricky rules get a worked EXAMPLE, and advice is kept to one-line
  player's notes. The in-game Guide is the new Field Manual.
  - How hard a move lands, what moves its audience, and what happens at the
    end of each week are explained in plain words, with pictures of worked
    examples and the game's own hover card.
  - Field Manual: sections 1.0 to 15.0 in the order a week is played, then
    Appendix A (reference tables), B (glossary, plain and military side by
    side), C (player aid) and D (sources and credits).
  - Practitioner's Manual: the eight campaigns (moved from the Field Manual),
    sessions, the White Cell, the debrief, the model in numbers, the editor,
    designer's notes keyed to the Field Manual's rule numbers, and a new
    section on sources and limits, with a facilitator's checklist and a
    debrief question bank.
- **New: a two-sided player aid.** The Field Manual's Appendix C, also as its
  own PDF to print on one sheet.
- **Fixes.** Humanoid Robots now says it also gives Plant Stories +1 grade,
  as it always has. The tutorial points to the Guide's section on the
  opponents. General edits to documentation for clarity.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.17 builds.
